## Checklist

- [ ] The linked item is authorized and ready, or an explicit owner exception is recorded.
- [ ] Declared scope is at least as strict as the actual diff.
- [ ] Evidence and approvals apply to the current head SHA.
- [ ] Required commands propagate failures.
- [ ] Compatibility, changelog, migration, security, and release effects are addressed.
- [ ] No required check, test, publication, or release protection was weakened.
